ITEM 1 | Small round grains, tan-beige to light brown, uniform size (about 2-3 mm each), matte surface with slight sheen, cluster in a mound on the upper-left of the plate with scattered loose grains spreading outward; mixed with small flecks of green herb pieces and pale yellow-green bits, moist and clumping but not flowing | 95
ITEM 2 | Sliced orange-red vegetable pieces, roughly round coin-like slices about 3-4 cm across and 0.5 cm thick, bright orange with slightly darker edges, glossy and moist with a light sheen, some slices overlapping in a heap, lower-right of plate, with a few small grains scattered among them | 120
